summary: Harney County, OR, 40-foot wooden L-4 lookout built 1952 and removed in 1970; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Tower removed in 1970; no tower remains to climb

events.note: All three pages date the 40-foot wooden tower to 1952
Register says removed; firelookout.com says destroyed. Both give 1970
Date registered June 24, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: built 1952 as a 40-foot wooden L-4 tower; removed 1970
evidence.quote: Built in 1952, this 40' wooden L-4 tower was removed in 1970.

evidence.supports: July 1952 inspection describes a new 40-foot wood tower
evidence.quote: This point has a new 40-foot wood tower which is an excellent piece of construction.

evidence.supports: two split diagonals that should be replaced
evidence.quote: There were two diagonals split in the lower panel which should be replaced.

evidence.supports: one bolt missing in the 1952 inspection
evidence.quote: Also there is one bolt missing due to slightly mismatched holes.

evidence.supports: Oregon Lookouts lists the tower as removed, undated
location Ochoco National Forest, Harney County
administered by the U.S. Forest Service

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says removed and firelookout.com says destroyed; both give 1970, so the disagreement is about how the tower came down, not when.

notes_for_editor: The history is consistent across all three pages: 40-foot wooden tower built 1952, removed or destroyed 1970. Height 12.2 m is the 40-ft figure converted. No source describes the site today or its access, so no access or visit facts were written. Ochoco National Forest and Harney County are both listed on the register page. A human should confirm the forest's extent, since our sources do not settle which county the forest lies in. One web search was run for this site; its results were not used as sources. The site photos on firetower.org (a 1963 view credited to Howard Verschoor's collection and a 2002 site view) have no licence stated, so no photo entries were added. The brief's agency spelling 'U.S.Forest Service' is a spacing typo in the source and is written 'U.S. Forest Service' here.
